name: travel-plan-saved

init: document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => { const s = document.createElement('style'); s.dataset.compare = 'static'; s.textContent = '#journey-view { position: static !important; max-height: none !important; overflow: visible !important; } .plan-back-row, .plan-actions { position: static !important; }'; document.head.append(s); })

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => { const s = document.createElement('style'); s.dataset.compare = 'static'; s.textContent = '#journey-view { position: static !important; max-height: none !important; overflow: visible !important; } .plan-back-row, .plan-actions { position: static !important; }'; document.head.append(s); })

note: Measuring aid, on both sides alike: the planner's own scrolling, the planner itself and its sticky bars (back row, Show the way / Add to plan) are made static (beside the mock's long sample board the sticky planner is pushed 8px lower than beside the app's empty past-day board), so an element scrolled into view for its screenshot isn't covered by a sticky bar or measured at a different scroll; layout and styles are otherwise untouched. After Add to plan both pages scroll back to the top: the click scrolls the page to reach the button, and only the mock's long sample Nearby board keeps it scrolled, with the sticky planner beside it.
